reviews.title: Steep price for style
reviews.comment: We all know why we get this case, we love OSRS. The case itself is amazing, looks clean and is absolutely huge with ample room for parts. The game mat is worth mentioning as it easily coves a good 70-80% of my desk and looks great. If you just want to build a pc I wouldn't recommend this as there are vastly cheaper options, however if you love osrs and want a case that shows that this will not disappoint you.
